title: Associate General Counsel, Privacy
description:
Ready to do the most impactful work of your career? At Coinbase , we are uncompromising on our mission to increase economic freedom. The bar is high, the environment is intense, and we like it that way. This isn't a place for complacency, it’s a place to be pushed past your perceived limits. If you're ready to build the future of finance alongside people who refuse to settle for "good enough," you belong here. Coinbase is a remote-first, but not remote-only company. Expect to get together quarterly for intense in-person working sessions called “surges.” learn more about working at Coinbase .
 As Associate General Counsel, you'll join Coinbase's Privacy Legal team reporting to the Managing General Counsel. You'll serve as a senior legal advisor on privacy and data protection across the company's global operations. This role sits at the intersection of product development, regulatory strategy, and data governance, advising teams on how to build privacy-forward products while navigating a rapidly evolving regulatory landscape. You'll partner with Privacy Operations, Product Counsel, Security, and Engineering to shape Coinbase's privacy program, translate complex global requirements into actionable guidance, and represent the company with regulators and government agencies in one of its most important markets.
 What you'll do:
 Own the development, implementation, and scaling of Coinbase's global privacy program in partnership with Privacy Operations, including policy drafting, data protection agreements, and transparency reports
 Lead cross-functional privacy initiatives spanning data governance, data protection tooling, and data subject rights processes in collaboration with CX, Engineering, and international teams
 Partner with Product and Commercial Counsel to embed privacy-by-design principles into the product development and launch lifecycle, translating regulatory requirements into clear, actionable product guidance

title: Projektmanager Influencer Marketing (m/w/d)
description:
Du möchtest Influencer-Kampagnen nicht nur begleiten, sondern eigenständig steuern und zum Erfolg führen?
 Bei der LikeGroup betreust du dein eigenes Kundenportfolio und verantwortest Influencer-Marketing-Kampagnen von der Planung bis zum Reporting. Gleichzeitig unterstützt du unsere Team Leads bei der Umsetzung großer Key-Account-Projekte.
 Wir sind eine der führenden Creator- und Influencer-Marketing-Agenturen Deutschlands. Mit 33 Kolleg:innen, einem Netzwerk aus über 12.000 Creatorn und mehr als 80 Marken entwickeln wir Kampagnen, die nicht nur Reichweite schaffen, sondern messbare Ergebnisse liefern.
 Aufgaben
 Du betreust deine zugeordneten Kunden vollständig und eigenverantwortlich.
 Du bist die zentrale Ansprechperson für deine Kunden und berätst sie strategisch und operativ.
 Du planst, steuerst und realisierst Influencer- und Creator-Marketing-Kampagnen.
 Du stellst sicher, dass Deadlines, Budgets und vereinbarte Leistungen eingehalten werden.
 Du übernimmst Verantwortung für die Qualität und die Ergebnisse deiner Projekte.
 Du koordinierst Projektmitarbeitende und Creative Specialists.
 Du verteilst Aufgaben, kontrollierst die Umsetzung und hältst offene Punkte konsequent nach.
 Du erkennst Risiken und Herausforderungen frühzeitig und entwickelst gemeinsam mit dem Team Lead passende Lösungen.
 Du unterstützt unsere Team Leads operativ bei der Betreuung großer Key Accounts.
 Du pflegst unsere Projekt-, Budget- und Reporting-Systeme vollständig und zuverlässig.
 Du bereitest Reportings, Learnings und Handlungsempfehlungen für deine Kunden auf.
 Qualifikation
 Du verfügst idealerweise über erste Berufserfahrung im Projektmanagement, Account Management, Influencer Marketing oder Social Media.
 Du arbeitest strukturiert, eigenständig und lösungsorientiert.
 Du behältst auch bei mehreren parallelen Kampagnen den Überblick über Timings, Budgets und Verantwortlichkeiten.

title: WHOLESALE DIRECTOR EMEA & APAC (Maternity Leave Cover)
description:
ANINE BING is looking for a Wholesale Director EMEA & APAC to join our Wholesale team based in Paris, covering a maternity leave.

This is a fixed-term contract (CDD), starting early December 2026 for the duration of the absence of the employee being replaced — expected to run through approximately May 2027, with the exact end date depending on the return of the employee on leave. A structured handover is planned in two steps: an initial transition with the outgoing Director around mid-December 2026, and a second handover at the end of the assignment, around her return in May 2027.

As a key contributor within our Paris HQ team, the Wholesale Director EMEA & APAC steps into an existing commercial organization and ensures continuity of leadership for our EMEA & APAC wholesale business during the interim period. The role directly manages a team of four — two Wholesale Managers EU + ME/APAC, one ADV Manager EU, and one Wholesale Support Intern — and owns the commercial and operational performance of a multi-market portfolio operated through key accounts, agents, and franchise partners. The role also works closely with our Wholesale Strategic Advisor, an internal resource who supports continuity throughout the assignment.

This is a hybrid position based at our Paris HQ, with a preference for in-person work. The role reports to the CEO.

Responsibilities Include:

  • Provide day-to-day leadership to the two Wholesale Managers EU + ME/APAC, the ADV Manager EU, and the Wholesale Support Intern, ensuring business continuity and uninterrupted decision-making during the interim period
  • Own the commercial performance of the ME & APAC wholesale portfolio — sell-in, sell-through, forecasting, and seasonal budgets acro…

title: RTW INTERN DESIGNER F/M
description:
ANINE BING is looking for an RTW Intern Designer (F/M) to join our PAP Studio team based in Paris.

This role is an opportunity to help shape the next chapter of ANINE BING. As a key contributor within our Paris HQ team, the RTW Intern Designer supports the PAP Studio in day-to-day coordination and collection development, bringing precision and creative energy to their work — supporting our global growth while staying grounded in the brand's DNA: refined, fast-moving, and always evolving.

We're looking for someone who thrives in a creative yet performance-driven environment. The ideal candidate combines a sharp eye for detail with a clear sense of the big picture, is comfortable moving between technical execution and creative research, and is energized by building something special—together.

This is an internship based at our Paris HQ, in-person, for a minimum duration of 6 months. The role reports to the Head of Design, with a dotted line to the Senior Designer.

Responsibilities Include:

  • Studio coordination & collection support: produce technical drawings on Illustrator, update and maintain technical files (tech packs), and keep collection boards, moodboards, and working boards current throughout the season.
  • Design execution: color and finish sketches, build collection boards, produce presentation mock-ups and supports, and develop digital color ranges.
  • Research: conduct iconographic research on styles, finishes, materials and details, and develop visual references to support collection direction.
  • File management: organize and maintain collection files and digital archives.
